The macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate released today includes a short video that appears to showcase the Visual Intelligence feature on the rumored AirPods with cameras. You can see it below.

macOS 26.7 Contains Demonstration Footage of AirPods With Cameras

MacRumors discovered that today's macOS Tahoe 26.7 RC includes a short video in which a man wearing AirPods appears to ask Siri to take note of the book he is reading, with Siri's voiceover saying:

The camera is not visible in the video, and the earbuds look very similar to the existing AirPods Pro. The most obvious difference is the stem, which appears to be slightly thicker.

Aaron Perris has also posted the same video to X:

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman has previously reported that Apple may launch AirPods with cameras this year, with the codename B790. Earlier today, MacRumors also discovered references to B790 within the macOS 26.7 RC, including code for 'image stream'.

Interestingly, these AirPods are reportedly not the same as another camera-equipped model (codenamed B798) that Bloomberg says Apple is developing, which is not expected to launch until 2027.

Given that Apple chose to hide this demonstration footage within macOS 26.7 RC, the AirPods with cameras are very likely to be officially unveiled at next month's iPhone event.

What do you think of the video? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
